title: Portugal
subtitle: from the Douro to Cabo da Roca
leg: Santiago de Compostela to Lisbon, the last stretch from Singapore
standfirst: Photos from Portugal in December 2015: Porto, Aveiro and Lisbon, then out past Cascais to Cabo da Roca. In from Santiago de Compostela; the last stop on the overland leg from Singapore.

cover.alt: The stone cross on its column at Cabo da Roca against the sunset, people along the railing in silhouette

music.title: O Mar Novo: «As Vagas de Nazaré»
music.blurb: For wind band, on the great Atlantic winter waves that break off Nazaré, on this coast between Aveiro and Lisbon.

stops.caption: Porto, on the Douro near its mouth, the first stop after crossing from Galicia. Houses stack up the hill from the Ribeira; São Bento station is in the centre.

photos.alt: Tall houses with iron balconies and laundry hanging out, a corrugated-iron wall and tiled roofs behind
The clock and mansard roof of São Bento station against a clear sky
A francesinha: melted cheese over the sandwich, two sausages on top, in a dish of orange sauce

stops.caption: Aveiro, on the lagoon of the Ria de Aveiro. Canals through the centre with painted moliceiro boats, once used to gather seaweed; Art Nouveau fronts along the main canal; salt marsh at the edge of town.

photos.alt: Moliceiro boats moored on the central canal, Art Nouveau and tiled buildings along the quay
A pão de ló sponge cake in a shop window, priced at 3.50 euros, custard tarts beside it
A red parking meter marked Aveiro 250 in front of tiled houses
A small white hut on the salt marsh, reflected in still water
A painted moliceiro boat heading down a canal towards a footbridge
A café counter of coconut cakes, flaky pastries in a box, burnt-top egg pastries and almond tarts at one euro each

stops.caption: Lisbon, at the mouth of the Tagus and the end of the road west. Tiled fronts and trams in the old town; downriver at Belém, the tower and the Monument to the Discoveries face the Atlantic.

photos.alt: The Monument to the Discoveries: stone navigators, a friar and a figure holding a scroll of verse, climbing the prow of a ship
A charred egg pastry on a napkin beside a small black coffee
A grey-tiled corner building, a red tram turning on the street below
The battlements of Belém Tower, carved with crosses, the Tagus behind
Roast chestnuts on paper beside a street seller's smoking burner
A pink stepped gable with peeling plaster, a pedestrian-crossing sign in front
A narrow street between old plastered buildings, a strip of blue sky above

stops.caption: Cabo da Roca, out past Cascais, the westernmost point of mainland Europe. The monument carries Camões’s line «Onde a terra se acaba e o mar começa».

photos.alt: Cliffs dropping into the Atlantic, a rock in the surf below
Sunset over the Atlantic, the sky orange and blue above a band of cloud
